provenance_note: Synthetic benchmark dataset representing a typical semi-intensive dairy herd in Southern Karnataka experiencing summer thermal stress and feed cost inflation.

water_consumption.observation: Daily water intake per cow dropped from 78L to 64L during a period when high ambient heat typically demands an increase to 95L-110L.

current_feed_ration.margin_assumptions: Calculated as daily milk revenue (410L * ₹38 = ₹15,580) minus daily herd feed expenditure (₹5,424). Excludes fixed labour and electricity overheads.

environmental_conditions.shed_ventilation_type: Naturally ventilated with partial corrugated tin roof
environmental_conditions.interpretation: THI exceeds critical threshold of 72. High heat and humidity cause accelerated respiration, reduced rumination, and heat-induced milk yield suppression.

active_alerts.message: Ambient THI reached 86.8 (35.5°C, 68% RH). Severe heat stress index for lactating cows.
Herd water consumption declined by 17.9% despite high ambient heat. Risk of water trough heating or restricted access.
Commercial concentrate price spiked +18% (₹28 -> ₹33/kg), elevating daily herd feed cost to ₹5,424.
2 cows flagged with acute health deviations requiring urgent veterinary physical examination.

animals_requiring_attention.suspected_issue: Elevated thermal distress / systemic infection with tachycardia and pyrexia
animals_requiring_attention.action_required: Immediate veterinary physical examination; isolate under shaded misting stall; check for tick-borne hemoparasites.

animals_requiring_attention.appetite_observation: Moderate appetite, sluggish movement, eating green fodder only
animals_requiring_attention.suspected_issue: Sudden 35% milk drop; right rear quarter firmness noticed during morning milking (Early clinical mastitis indicator)
animals_requiring_attention.action_required: California Mastitis Test (CMT); milk sample collection; prompt veterinary antibiotic and anti-inflammatory protocol.

animals_requiring_attention.suspected_issue: Mild isolated elevation in resting heart rate on warm afternoon; no clinical distress
animals_requiring_attention.action_required: Re-check resting heart rate in cool evening; veterinary consult only if elevated vitals persist or other symptoms develop.
